scope: Complete deferred recut contact-power and residual-rotation investigations; retain ordinary game physics.

decision.recut: Manual recut follow-through after actual bounded intervention causes live-target cuts; no new damage/strength multiplier justified. Not an every-strike nondecrease guarantee.
decision.spin: Selected release endpoints settle; sabre peak is one native head-collision step. Post-step body-grip clamp candidate not adopted because it leaves the integrated pose jump and extends momentum removal.

gravityAnswer.scope: same-height free fall from rest; not a measured game-damage gain
gravityAnswer.mass: same acceleration and proportional gain at equal conditions; heavier mass has a larger absolute added fall energy, while held-weapon attack and recovery depend on controller, alignment and contacts
